trade.text: She opposed the president's unilateral tariffs as taxes imposed on Americans without congressional approval.
trade.quote: He imposed taxes on the American people without congressional approval. Congress allowed that to happen. Under my watch, my vote would never allow such a thing to happen.

schools.text: She proposes substantially increasing federal investment in underfunded public schools and communities.
schools.quote: Our plan will significantly increase federal investment in public education and target resources toward schools and communities that have historically been underfunded.

immigration.text: She says people facing deportation must retain legal rights and lawful process.
immigration.quote: No president should be able to order the federal government to arrest people, imprison them, remove them from the country, or strip away their rights without lawful process.

abortion.text: She said she wants her granddaughters to retain control over decisions about their health care and bodies.
abortion.quote: I have nine granddaughters. I want each and every one of them to be able to vote and make decisions about their own health care, their own bodies.

tax.text: Stutzman voted for legislation making the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act permanent.
tax.quote: This bill will codify President Donald J. Trump’s America First agenda and ensure the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act remains permanent.

trade.text: Stutzman introduced legislation authorizing tariffs of up to 70 percent on specified Australian Wagyu imports.
trade.quote: To level the playing field for American Wagyu farmers, Rep. Stutzman’s bill opens the door for the President to place a tariff of up to 70% on Wagyu meat, semen, and conventional embryos imported from Australia.

housing.text: Stutzman sponsored legislation streamlining federal reviews and inspections to make rural housing easier to build.
housing.quote: Streamlining environmental reviews and inspections to lower housing costs is a straightforward bipartisan issue that should pass the Senate without delay. Hoosiers and Americans across the country need more affordable housing, and the House of Representatives just delivered real results.

schools.text: Stutzman advocates expanding educational choices and giving parents and states greater control over schooling.
schools.quote: Having more school/educational choices and encouraging parental involvement are proven ways to make sure that students succeed, and this can be done on the state level in a variety of ways.

safety.text: Stutzman introduced a fentanyl bill providing additional funding for drug detection, staffing, and enforcement.
safety.quote: Authorizes $9,000,000 to support enhanced drug detection, staffing, and enforcement capabilities within the Postal Service.

immigration.text: Stutzman calls finishing the southern border wall a priority and supports a legal system focused on border security.
immigration.quote: From day one, I have advocated to finish the wall on the southern border as soon as possible, and as your Congressman I will work to create a legal system that protects our citizens from the threats we already face and ensure that our national security is strengthened at every level.

guns.text: Stutzman cites legislation he authored to expand concealed-carry and Second Amendment protections.
guns.quote: With a lifetime A rating from the NRA, I have defended our right to bear arms by co-authoring the Lifetime Handgun Permit in Indiana and authoring The Constitutional Concealed Carry Reciprocity Act as well as the Separation of Powers Restoration and Second Amendment Protection Act in the US Congress.

abortion.text: Stutzman says he authored state and federal bills intended to protect unborn life.
abortion.quote: I authored multiple bills on the state and federal level trying to protect the lives of the unborn in any way possible.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Stutzman stated that biological males should not be eligible to play in the WNBA.
gender.quote: The WNBA needs to stop denying common sense and admit that biological males have no place in their league

health.text: Stutzman advocates Health Savings Accounts, portable coverage, business tax credits, and other market-based health-care policies.
health.quote: Expanding free market solutions like Health Savings Accounts, transportable coverage, tax credits for businesses which provide health care and providing protection for doctors from frivolous lawsuits are the first steps toward providing access to the quality care Americans need.
